videos.title: The Counterfeit Station
videos.synopsis: Gyroid and Emmy run the viaduct into the Counterfeit Station, where every board reads like a torus. A cloaked station master throws off his cloak: the Commutator. Null's Crown blazes over the dais: three trials, and the Cup Product Gardens are the stake.

scenes.title: The viaduct
scenes.description: Night. Gyroid and Emmy sprint along a viaduct over a violet sea toward a station where four lines meet; a colossal stone torus arch with a clock rises behind it.

scenes.title: The boards
scenes.description: Departure boards flicker: H⁰ ℤ · H¹ ℤ² · H² ℤ. Every board reads like a torus.

scenes.title: The station master
scenes.description: A cloaked figure waits on the dais. He throws off the cloak: the Commutator, his four loop pauldrons blazing.

scenes.title: The Crown
scenes.description: The Crown above the dais blazes and Null speaks through it. Three sigils light on the concourse; Crown shards orbit the dais.

scenes.title: Title
scenes.description: Title card: World 3 · Castle — The Counterfeit Station.

captions.speaker: Narrator
captions.text: The Counterfeit Station: where every line in Winding World meets. Tonight, every train runs to one platform.

captions.speaker: Emmy Boundary
captions.text: Look at the boards. ℤ, ℤ², ℤ. Every one reads like a torus. Same groups, Gyroid. That proves nothing yet.

captions.speaker: The Commutator
captions.text: Welcome to my station, courier. A torus, a ℂP², a closed manifold. I am whatever your counts say I am.

captions.speaker: Gyroid
captions.text: a b a⁻¹ b⁻¹. The Commutator. I’d know that word anywhere.

captions.speaker: Count Null
captions.text: Gyroid. Emmy. My marshal keeps this station now. Three trials. Fail one, and I fold the Cup Product Gardens. Every lantern. Every path.

captions.speaker: Emmy Boundary
captions.text: We don’t just count any more. We multiply.

captions.speaker: Gyroid
captions.text: Then let’s see what he’s really wearing.

videos.title: Null’s Last Lesson
videos.plays: After castle-3's final phase — the end of World 3
videos.synopsis: Unmasked, the Commutator begs for one more chance. Null descends and shows a map S³ → S² that every cohomology class reads as zero, and calls it trivial. Then he discards his marshal: the Crown folds the Façade to a point and reaches for the Commutator; Gyroid drags him clear as his loops go dark. Null rises up the Postnikov Spire with a threat: every map S³ → S² is trivial; prove one isn't, or the sky is next. At dawn, resolve: homotopy groups.

scenes.title: Unmasked
scenes.description: Smoke on the concourse. The Commutator kneels on the dais, his mask cracked.

scenes.title: Null descends
scenes.description: Null comes down out of the Crown's light onto the dais beside his kneeling marshal.

scenes.title: The claim
scenes.description: Null holds out S³ and S² and a map between them. Gyroid's cup reads only zeros: H²(S³) = 0.

scenes.title: Discarded
scenes.description: Null turns from his marshal. The Crown's beam strikes the Façade; the Commutator's four loop pauldrons begin to fade.

scenes.title: The Façade folds
scenes.description: The great stone torus closes into a ball, shrinks to a hanging point, flashes. The dais sinks; Gyroid sprints in and drags the Commutator clear.

scenes.title: Reactions
scenes.description: The Commutator stares at his dark loops. Gyroid, quiet and hard. Emmy, stricken: these were her presses.

scenes.title: Null rises
scenes.description: Null rises on a violet ribbon toward the Postnikov Spire on the horizon, the Crown glowing at its top.

scenes.title: Resolve
scenes.description: Dawn over the broken station. They look at the Spire.

scenes.title: World 3 complete
scenes.description: Card: World 3 complete — Cup Product Gardens restored.

captions.speaker: Emmy Boundary
captions.text: Three trials. Three rings. Your station was never any of the things it claimed.

captions.speaker: The Commutator
captions.text: Master. One more chance. I can still be anything you need.

captions.speaker: Count Null
captions.text: Hush, marshal. You did your best. It was not enough. Courier, one last lesson before I go.

captions.speaker: Count Null
captions.text: Take any map from S³ to S². Read it with your rings. Every one of them.

captions.speaker: Gyroid
captions.text: It pulls H²(S²) back into H²(S³)… and that’s zero. Every class reads zero.

captions.speaker: Count Null
captions.text: Then it is nothing. Every map S³ → S² is trivial. A point in a sphere’s clothing. Like him.

captions.speaker: Count Null
captions.text: I have no use for a marshal who loses.

captions.speaker: Narrator
captions.text: The Crown took the Façade first. Its hole closed. The ring became a ball. The ball became a point.

captions.speaker: Narrator
captions.text: Then it reached for the marshal who had served it.

captions.speaker: Gyroid
captions.text: Got you. He’d have folded you with the floor.

captions.speaker: The Commutator
captions.text: My loops… all four. He never once said my name.

captions.speaker: Emmy Boundary
captions.text: That’s what my presses do now. To anyone who stops being useful to him.

captions.speaker: Count Null
captions.text: Climb my Spire, courier. Up there, every map S³ → S² is trivial. Prove one isn’t, or the sky is next.

captions.speaker: Narrator
captions.text: And Count Null rose on a ribbon of violet, up the Postnikov Spire.

captions.speaker: Emmy Boundary
captions.text: f* sends every class to zero: pulling back can’t see that map. So we stop reading the spaces and count the maps themselves: homotopy groups.

captions.speaker: Gyroid
captions.text: Then we climb. Bend it, don’t break it, and prove it. All the way to the top.
